topic: Data source issues and session restoration
summary_markdown:
The initial tab analysis revealed that many facilities did not have complete data sources, requiring the reuploading of virtual sessions. The speaker noted they do not currently have a script for this process and anticipates completing the first tab by the next day.
[p1] confirmed that some cases had adequate source data but problematic facility status, suggesting it might fit the same recovery case, though acknowledging the need for separate documentation. [me] clarified that while the technical restoration method is different, the core issue remains the same as previously described.
decisions: The first tab analysis will be completed by the next day.
action_items: Develop a script or process to handle facilities requiring virtual session reuploading.
